summary: The handful and the frankincense together make a mincha allowed. If a wrong plan was only with one of them, Rabbi Meir says it is piggul, but the Sages say it is piggul only if the wrong plan was with everything that makes it allowed. The same argument applies to the lambs and bowls of Shavuos and the lechem hapanim.
